response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) as avg_got, AVG(RBC) as avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall_avg_got AS (SELECT AVG(avg_got) as mean_got FROM patient_averages WHERE avg_got IS NOT NULL) SELECT pa.ID, pa.avg_got, pa.avg_rbc, pa.avg_got - oag.mean_got as difference FROM patient_averages pa CROSS JOIN overall_avg_got oag WHERE oag.mean_got IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN pa.avg_got IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, pa.avg_got - oag.mean_got DESC LIMIT 10
